reviewRound3: Important (cold-cache race in claudeCodeBlock): fixed by construction, as the architect asked to judge it. In the block rendered at 801c8894 the only filesystem call on the shared cache before the flock is `mkdir -p -- "$cache" 2>/dev/null`, which succeeds when another role has just made the directory; the regular-file recovery `{ rm -f -- "$cache" && mkdir -p -- "$cache"; }` runs only when that mkdir fails. The old line's failure after the race shown deterministically: with the directory already made, `rm -f -- "$cache"` printed `rm: cannot remove 'c': Is a directory` and the subshell exited 1 before npm; the new line in the same state reached npm, exit 0. The race itself was not reproduced, and per the architect no attempt was made to hunt it.
